selected.look_here_first: Look for broad basal leaves and terminal clusters of small composite heads; inspect three-lobed florets and the surrounding phyllaries.
Notice divided leaves and blue-violet tubular flowers; inspect corolla lobes, floral tube and stamens before comparing other gilias.
Inspect finely divided narrow leaves and clustered pale disk-only composite flower heads; look closely at the phyllaries.
Inspect compound legume leaves, small pink-red pea flowers and seed pods; confirm leaflet numbers and pod hairs.
Look for a sprawling plant with paired leaflets, yellow five-petaled flowers and a segmented fruit; examine fruit texture.
Recognize finely bipinnate leaves and spherical golden flower heads; check leaflets and flattened bean pods.
Check opposite slender leaves and relatively long tubular yellow flowers; inspect corolla lobes and developing capsule.
Look for narrow basal leaves and umbels of white six-tepal flowers on naked stems; check flower stalks and bulb traits.
Inspect fine opposite leaves and tiny greenish flowers protected by papery bracts; magnify the crowded nodes.
Find a low basal rosette and narrow flowering spikes; examine capsules, their opening and reddish mature seeds.
